title: Dental SEO Marketing: Google Ads Mistakes Dentists Make

facts.fact: The page recommends refining Google Ads location targeting to a radius of typically 5-10 km around the dental practice.
facts.quote: you should refine your location targeting to include only areas within a comfortable radius of your practice, typically a 5-10 km radius.

facts.fact: The page recommends that dentists set aside time monthly to analyse Google Ads performance, test new ad creatives, adjust targeting, and refine bidding.
facts.quote: Set aside time monthly to analyse ad performance, test new ad creatives, adjust targeting, and refine your bidding strategies.

facts.fact: The page lists common negative keywords for dental practices as "free," "cheap," "jobs," and "DIY."
facts.quote: Common negative keywords for dental practices include “free,” “cheap,” “jobs,” and “DIY.”
